sections.heading: What we found
sections.text: Lot 4417 (part B-220) was stamped on Press 3 on May 4, 2021 at 4:15 PM, second shift, operator OP-121. During that run Press 3 logged machine stop code 101. The lot was deburred on Bench 2 on May 7 at 2:24 PM.

sections.heading: Other lots that may be affected
sections.text: Lot 4418: same machine, 1 hour later, same operator and shift, same day. Lot 4416: same machine, 2 hours earlier, same machine stop, code 5, same operator and shift, same day. Lot 4419: same machine, 3 hours later, same operator and shift, same day.
